name: Sapphira
overview: The account of Sapphira, wife of Ananias, in Acts 5 reveals a sobering lesson about honesty before God. Together, they sold property but deceitfully withheld part of the proceeds while claiming to give the full amount to the apostles. Peter confronts Ananias, exposing the sin as lying not just to men but to the Holy Spirit, resulting in Ananias's sudden death. This narrative underscores the seriousness of hypocrisy and falsehood in the early church, highlighting that God’s holiness demands truthfulness in the community of believers.
